title: 第20章 铁胎弓连珠箭，一夜回到解放前
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
黑市从外面看着破败。

    里面倒是热闹非凡。

    刀枪剑戟，武功秘籍，灵丹妙药，应有尽有。

    只是来这里闲逛采购的武者倒是不多。

    眼看着陆林进来，不少摊贩的目光都转了过来。

    “小哥，来看看，我这里有上好的刀剑，都是精钢打造，吹毛断发，不在话下。”

    “小哥，我这有破甲箭，穿心箭，流光箭，子母箭，快来瞧瞧，量大给你算便宜些。”

    “小哥，我这有下九门出来的好东西，你过来看看有没有需要的。”

    对于刀剑兵器，陆林并没有需求。

    他之前在花豹洞里，找了一把钢刀，上山捕猎，下山防身足够用了。

    倒是对那卖箭矢的有兴趣。

    陆林凑近。

    摊子上的箭矢足有十几种。

    破甲箭他已经见过，效果拔群。

    三百个铜钱一支。

    陆林一口气拿了十支。

    穿心箭的穿透力极强。

    据摊主说，山里的野猪皮，连一箭都扛不住。

    箭尖细而长，箭杆用精钢打造。

    四百五十铜钱一支。

    陆林想到答应陆大勇的任务，也一口气拿了十支。

    流光箭速度快，箭杆短小，箭头锋利。

    价格只有二百三铜钱一支。

    拿十支。

    再看子母箭，射到空中大约三秒后会散出十余根细针。

    攻击力虽然不强，但覆盖范围广，只是价格有些贵。

    一支就要六百铜钱。

    陆林没敢多拿，只买了三支。

    只是一些箭矢，陆林就花了快十二两，店家还想推销其他的箭矢，带倒刺，带火药的。

    陆林囊中羞涩，连连拒绝。

    继续向前走。

    没几步就被一个黄脸汉子拦住。

    “小哥，买弓吗？我家祖传的铁胎弓。”

    汉子一脸难色，看着陆林的时候，眼中满是希冀。

    只是铁胎弓，陆林也没有见过，不知道效果如何。

    “小哥，我家祖上出过一位将军，还是入了品的三品武者，只是我们后人不争气。”

    “如今我爹娘病重，急需银钱治疗，这才不得不把铁胎弓拿出来贱卖。”

    一听这话，陆林下意识后退半步。

    这是经典的骗局。

    祖传宝刀。

    父母重病。

    儿孙无能。

    贱卖宝刀。
content_en:
The black market looks dilapidated from the outside.

    It was quite lively inside.

    Swords, guns, swords and halberds, martial arts secrets, panaceas, everything.

    There are not many warriors who just come here to hang out and purchase.

    Seeing Lu Lin come in, many vendors turned their eyes.

    "Brother, come and take a look. I have excellent swords here. They are made of fine steel and can be used to blow hair or break hair."

    "Brother, I have armor-piercing arrows, heart-piercing arrows, streamer arrows, and double-jet arrows. Come and have a look. I'll give you a cheaper price if the quantity is large."

    "Brother, I have some good stuff from the Lower Nine Gates. Come over and see if you need anything."

    Lu Lin had no need for swords and weapons.

    He had found a steel knife in the Leopard Cave before, and it was enough for hunting when he went up the mountain, and it was enough for self-defense when he came down the mountain.

    I am actually interested in the arrow seller.

    Lu Lin came closer.

    There are more than a dozen types of arrows on the stall.

    He had already seen armor-piercing arrows, and they were extremely effective.

    Three hundred copper coins each.

    Lu Lin took ten of them in one go.

    The penetrating power of the heart-piercing arrow is extremely strong.

    According to the stall owner, the wild boar skin in the mountains cannot even hold an arrow.

    The arrow tip is thin and long, and the arrow shaft is made of fine steel.

    Four hundred and fifty copper coins each.

    Lu Lin thought of agreeing to Lu Dayong's mission, so he took ten of them in one go.

    Streamer arrows are fast, have short shafts, and sharp arrows.

    The price is only two hundred and three copper coins.

    Take ten.

    Looking at the Zimu arrow again, about three seconds after being shot into the air, more than ten fine needles will scatter.

    Although the attack power is not strong, it covers a wide range, but the price is a bit expensive.

    Each one costs six hundred copper coins.

    Lu Lin didn't dare to take more and only bought three.

    Lu Lin spent nearly twelve taels on just some arrows, and the store also wanted to sell other arrows, ones with barbs and gunpowder.

    Lu Lin was cash-strapped and refused again and again.

    Keep moving forward.

    After a few steps, he was stopped by a yellow-faced man.

    "Brother, do you want to buy a bow? My family's ancestral iron bow."

    The man looked troubled, and when he looked at Lu Lin, his eyes were full of hope.

    Lu Lin had never seen an iron tire bow before, so he didn't know how effective it would be.

    "Brother, my ancestors had a general who was a third-grade warrior, but our descendants did not live up to his expectations."

    "Now my parents are seriously ill and urgently need money for treatment, so I have to sell the iron bow at a low price."

    Upon hearing this, Lu Lin subconsciously took half a step back.

    This is a classic scam.

    An ancestral sword.

    Parents are seriously ill.

    Children and grandchildren are incompetent.

    Selling the sword cheaply.
title_en: Chapter 20: Iron-tired bows and arrows, returning to the pre-liberation period overnight
